issues.title: Latest Reese's Sodium Options versions for Minecraft 26.1 require an unavailable Sodium version
issues.body:
The latest two versions of Reese's Sodium Options that support Minecraft 26.1, v2.2.3 and v2.2.2, require a newer version of Sodium than is currently available for Minecraft 26.1.

The latest Sodium version available for Minecraft 26.1 is v0.8.9. However, both v2.2.3 and v2.2.2 of Reese's Sodium Options require a higher Sodium version and therefore cannot be used with Sodium v0.8.9.

There are six versions of Reese's Sodium Options listed on Modrinth as supporting Minecraft 26.1, but the two latest versions cannot be used with the latest available Sodium version for that Minecraft version.

issues.title: Compatibility with modern Sodium 0.8.12 alpha backports to 1.21.1
issues.body:
Hi,
I'm a maintainer on Sodium and today we published the first alpha from our graduated backport experiment. This means that we [now have Sodium 0.8.12 on 1.21.1](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium/versions?c=alpha&g=1.21.1). You can find more information about this [in our blog post on discord](https://discord.com/channels/602796788608401408/1077645005042233374/1501010160326414426).

We've since noticed Reese's Sodium Options interacting with Sodium and crashing on load. The gist is that since 0.8.x includes many changes to various parts of Sodium, including our new Config API, mods such as Sable or this one, will encounter breakage when users (cluelessly) update modpacks with the latest published versions.

If you'd like to coordinate more closely with us, you're invited to [our discord server.](https://caffeinemc.net/discord) I intend for this to be considered a "feature" since this software is currently in alpha and not the mainline release. A lack of compatibility is not a fault on your part, but rather I would just like to notify you of the situation. I hope this doesn't cause too much trouble!

Thanks!

issues.title: [Feature Request] Implement Category Color Support (Consistent with Original Sodium UI)
issues.body: Subject: [Feature Request] Implement Category Color Support (Consistent with Original Sodium UI) Description: First of all, thank you for maintaining Reese's Options! It’s an essential mod for making Sodium’s settings much more manageable and user-friendly. I would like to suggest an update to bring back the Category Color Support found in the original Sodium interface. The Problem: In the vanilla Sodium UI, each category (General, Quality, Performance, Advanced) is visually distinguished by specific colors (e.g., Orange for Performance, Red for Advanced). This provides immediate visual feedback, making it easier for users to navigate. Currently, Reese’s Options uses a more uniform color scheme, which—while clean—loses that intuitive "at-a-glance" navigation. Proposed Solution: Sync Category Colors: Update the tabs or category headers in Reese’s Options to reflect the original colors defined by Sodium. Visual Consistency: Ensure that when users switch from the default Sodium UI to Reese’s, the color language remains consistent. Why this would be beneficial: It combines the best of both worlds: the superior layout and scrolling of Reese's Options with the intuitive, color-coded UX of Sodium. It makes the interface feel more "official" and polished. Additional Context: Image on bottom [Optional: Attach a side-by-side screenshot showing the colored tabs in Sodium vs. the current Reese's UI here] Thank you for considering this request! Keep up the amazing work.
